formulations.Polymer system Notes: Poly(ethylene carbonate) (PEC) with lithium salts (LiX; X = TFSI, ClO4, BF4, PF6) prepared by dissolving PEC in acetonitrile with Li salts, casting onto a plastic dish, drying in a vacuum at 60°C for 24 h, and introducing into a glove box filled with dry Ar gas.
formulations.Transference notes: Values increased with increasing salt concentration. LiTFSI showed the highest values (>0.5), while others decreased with concentration. Large anions (TFSI) promote Li+ migration.
formulations.Notes: PEC carbonate units to all units in the main chain ratio was approximately 95%.
formulations.Reference: Journal of The Electrochemical Society, 162 (2) A3133-A3136 (2015)
